scope: Read-only code and artifact audit. Existing inherited holdouts repeatedly reused; comparisons are diagnostic. No weight/threshold selected here.
limitations: Caches identify rows but not source bytes/configuration; invalidate before future parameter/data changes.
Teacher vectorizers/models and context price mappings are not serialized; CBM alone is not a standalone scorer. Reproduction requires raw data/script or cached teacher vectors.
OOF teacher sees 2/3 train rows whereas eval teacher sees all training rows; standard stacking refit distribution shift remains.
Production historical reference is hybrid: base refitted70k, some auxiliary models frozen on development.
Condition is removed before features; top-level condition attributes filtered. Variation attribute values enter only aggregate counts, not direct value encodings.
